method: cursor-agent -p --trust [--mode plan|ask] --model auto, the model asked to list its tool definitions. A snapshot, not a per-run measurement: the CLI does not send its built-in tools, so no mock run can see them.

Shell.evidence: schema: shell_args and shell_stream_args are the same ShellArgs message (command, working_directory, description, is_background); background_shell_spawn_args takes command and working_directory

StrReplace.evidence: bundle: no edit exec type; EditArgs carries only path and stream_content, and LocalWriteExecutor asks approval for a fileEdit with a before/after diff, so the backend applies the replacement and sends the whole file

EditNotebook.evidence: inferred: no notebook exec type; same path as StrReplace

Grep.evidence: schema: GrepArgs pattern, path, glob, output_mode, context_before/after/context, case_insensitive, type, head_limit, offset, multiline

Glob.evidence: inferred: no glob exec type; GlobToolSuccess carries client_truncated and ripgrep_truncated, the fields of GrepFilesResult; LsArgs takes no pattern

Task.evidence: schema: SubagentArgs subagent_type, model_id, prompt, resume_agent_id, run_in_background

ReadLints.evidence: schema: DiagnosticsArgs path, one request per path

CallDynamicTool.evidence: schema: McpArgs name, args, provider_identifier, tool_name, server_identifier

FetchMcpResource.evidence: schema: ReadMcpResourceExecArgs server, uri, download_path, smart_mode_approval

WebFetch.evidence: schema: FetchArgs url; web_fetch_allowlist_precheck_args is the approval check

WebSearch.evidence: bundle: WebSearchArgs (search_term) exists only as a tool call; no exec type

AwaitShell.evidence: bundle: AwaitArgs (task_id, block_until_ms, regex) has no exec type; subagent_await_args takes an agent_id. The backend already holds the output of a shell it started through shell_stream_args

GetDynamicTools.evidence: bundle: GetMcpToolsArgs (server, tool_name, pattern) has no exec type; answered from the MCP definitions the client sent (run_request.mcp_tools, request_context.tools)

TodoWrite.evidence: bundle: UpdateTodosArgs (todos, merge) has no exec type

CreateGoal.evidence: bundle: CreateGoalArgs (objective) has no exec type

UpdateGoal.evidence: bundle: UpdateGoalArgs (status) has no exec type

SwitchMode.evidence: bundle: SwitchModeArgs (target_mode_id, explanation) has no exec type

CreatePlan.evidence: bundle: CreatePlanArgs (plan, todos, overview, name) has no exec type

GenerateImage.evidence: bundle: GenerateImageArgs has no exec type; WriteArgs.file_bytes is the only exec field that carries binary content, and whether the image lands through it is not verified
